platform.title: Platform
platform.subtitle: Every pharmacy on this installation, and the accounts inside them.
platform.footnote: Pharmacies and every account inside them are created here. A pharmacy manager can view and manage their own staff, but cannot create accounts.

newPharmacy.title: Create a pharmacy
newPharmacy.hint: The pharmacy and its first manager are created together. The manager can sign in immediately and manage that pharmacy's staff, patients and settings.

newPharmacy.timeZoneHint: Every dose, quiet hour and report is calculated in this zone.

addAccount.title: Add an account
addAccount.hint: Managers and doctors are the only accounts a pharmacy has. Only the platform owner can create them.
